note: Rustic recreation site in jack pine on the south shore of Beatty Lake, 28.8 km N of Green Lake off Hwy 155. Sandy ground with sparse undergrowth; boat launch and dock (motors 15 hp or less), fish-cleaning station and beach. Best for smaller rigs. --Claude
summary: Keep (provincial recreation site, thin sources). Tourism Saskatchewan listing current: 12 non-electric sites, boat launch, beach, fish cleaning; phone 306-837-2410 (Meadow Lake park office). Not on parks.saskatchewan.ca. PIN IS ~9 km OFF: stored point is on another lake's burned shore NE of the site -> 54.5120,-107.8788 (campground loop, Beatty Lake south shore). Not waterfront kept (loop under pine canopy ~40 m+ from the shore). Name: it is 'Beatty Lake Recreation Site', not a provincial park.
flags: PIN MOVE (~9 km): stored 54.5865,-107.8270 sits on the shore of an unnamed lake in burned/cut-over land with no campground (Esri z16). Esri z17 shows a single loop road in pines with a beach/day-use lot at 54.5116,-107.8803 on the lake's SE shore. Target 54.5120,-107.8788 (loop centre). Re-pin elevation (stored 465 m was for the wrong place). The stored inclusion_evidence 'satellite at 54.586,-107.827' looked at the wrong place too.

The loop sits under continuous jack-pine canopy (Tourism: 'A jackpine canopy extending from the shore of Beatty Lake shelters this campground'); its west edge is ~40 m from the shore through trees, so a view at best and no site numbers or photos to rest one on. The open lot by the beach is day use.
